purpose: Teach: 一人ひとり/要注意/停電/クッション/ワンピース/落ち込む/ねぎ/玉ねぎ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、近所、絶対、一人ひとり、絶対、大事にしたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran — do you remember? When your father was young, he really did cherish each of the neighbors, one by one. Absolutely.
lines.style: Slow, tender opening. Soft voice, reaching back into memory. Pause before the question. Warm affection on the final 'absolutely,' like he's reliving something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お酒、絶対、要注意、絶対、っておっしゃってたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. When your grandfather was young, he used to say — so seriously — that sake was something to be careful about. Do you remember, dear? Absolutely.
lines.style: Immediate, warm agreement. Slight laugh in her voice, affectionate and remembering. The middle thought lands gently, as if she can still hear him saying it. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、台風で、絶対、停電、絶対、心配されたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, gran, he really did worry about you during those typhoons — the blackouts especially. Do you remember? Absolutely.
lines.style: Soft, almost protective tone. The memory of concern comes through as care. Gentle pace. Slight emphasis on 'worry,' showing how much it mattered to him. Fades with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、クッション、絶対、選んでくださったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When your grandfather was young, he used to choose the nicest cushions for your father, you know. Do you remember that, dear? Absolutely.
lines.style: Bright recognition, almost delighted. Her voice lifts slightly as she recalls the small kindness. Tender attention to the detail. The 'dear' is warm and conspiratorial, like she's sharing a secret of his goodness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、ワンピース、絶対、お召しになってたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran wore the most elegant dresses back then, you know. Do you remember those? Absolutely.
lines.style: Admiring softness. His voice has a gentle, appreciative quality — he's seeing her young. Slow pace, almost dreamy. The memory is visual and tender. Quiet pride in the recollection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、商売、絶対、落ち込む、絶対、時期、絶対、辛そうだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When your grandfather's business was struggling, those were hard times for him, weren't they? I could see it. Do you remember, dear? Absolutely.
lines.style: Gentle, understanding tone. She's not dwelling on the hardship — she's validating that she saw him through it. Soft, patient delivery. A slight firmness on 'see,' like she stood witness. Warm at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お庭で、絶対、ねぎ、絶対、育てたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You grew green onions in the garden back then, remember? Absolutely.
lines.style: Simple, direct memory. His voice is quiet and grounded. A small smile underneath — the detail is humble but real. Slow, like he can still see the garden. Trailing-off suggests the peace of that memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お味噌汁の、絶対、玉ねぎ、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When your grandfather was young, he loved the onions in miso soup so much, didn't he? Do you remember, dear? Absolutely.
lines.style: Warm, connecting detail. Her voice is gentle and knowing — she's linking his simple pleasures to her care. A small laugh underneath, affectionate. She's not just remembering; she's honoring what she knew he loved.
